name: SEN12MS: A Multi-Sensor Earth Observation Dataset for Fusion and Land Cover Mapping
description: SEN12MS is a large-scale curated benchmark dataset for multi-sensor earth observation and deep learning, published by the Technical University of Munich (TUM) and the German Aerospace Center (DLR). It comprises 180,662 georeferenced patch triplets of corresponding Sentinel-1 dual-polarimetric SAR imagery (VV, VH backscatter), Sentinel-2 multi-spectral optical imagery (all 13 spectral bands from visible to shortwave infrared), and MODIS-derived land cover maps (IGBP and LCCS classification schemes). Collected across 252 globally distributed geographic locations spanning all four meteorological seasons, each patch has a spatial dimension of 256x256 pixels at 10m nominal ground resolution. Patch triplets serve as the primary sample unit.
